units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 7:2">Sabb. VII, 2</cite> <he>הטוֹחֵן</he> he who grinds (on the Sabbath).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 36">Ex. R. s. 36</cite>, beg. <he>טוֹחֲנִין אותם</he> (the olives) are crushed.
Sot. 9ᵇ … ועקרן וטְחָנָן וכ׳ and Samson uprooted them (the mountains) and ground them against one another; Snh. 24ᵃ; a. fr.—Trnsf. to have sexual intercourse (cmp. μύλλω).
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 23:1">Pesik. R. s. 23-24</cite> (ed. Fr. p. 122ᵇ) <he>טוֹחֲנוֹ ברחיים</he>, v. infra, a. <cite ref="K00142"><he>כָּדַן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 31a:14">Kidd. 31ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ויש מַטְחִינוֹ ברחיים</he> and some one may make his father grind in the mill (v. supra, a. <cite ref="K00142"><he>כָּדַן</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Ketubot 59b:8">Keth. 59ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 5:5">ib. V, 5</cite>) <he>טוֹחֶנֶת ס״ד … מַטְחֶנֶת</he> you cannot mean that she must do the grinding?… she must attend to the grinding.
